issue.title: test_on_alias_edited_offers_commit_when_in_repo exceeds the flake-baseline gate
issue.description:
tests/test_models_panel_edit_outcomes.py::test_on_alias_edited_offers_commit_when_in_repo
is holding just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake red as a new reproducible flake
(records after 2026-08-15T17:22:27Z, at most 5 failures per run).

REPRODUCTION: just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake names this node alongside
sase-ob (fakey usage-limit ULP compare) and sase-mv (config-cache
test_selector_change_eventually_invalidates_merged_config). Host-local full-run
records that include this nodeid:

- 20260815T233355Z-7d7581a21cc7-137828-full-run.json (sase_11, cost, HEAD 7d7581a21,
  sole failure)
- 20260816T140637Z-78a9130f7536-939696-full-run.json (sase_15, cost, HEAD 78a9130f7,
  72-failure noisy run)
- 20260817T100828Z-cf7eeee03f6c-3358571-full-run.json (sase_18, fast, HEAD cf7eeee03,
  sole failure)

Two of the three records failed only this node, so it is not just a cascade victim.
A later just test-cost run on 2026-08-17 (monitor 9mp1g9hehqgv, 8 workers, 31946
passed / 10 skipped) passed the node, so it is intermittent under the full parallel
lane rather than a deterministic break.

The test pushes ModelsPanel, calls panel._on_alias_edited with a stub
AliasCommitOffer, then wait_for(ConfirmActionModal) and asserts the Commit & Push
copy. The store records only the nodeid, not the assertion; the likely shape is a
wait_for timeout or a missing modal under full-suite ACE/Textual load.

WHY IT MATTERS: after epic sase-ns.6.6 retired already-fixed baseline nodes, this
is a third live node (with sase-ob and sase-mv) keeping check-full's flake-baseline
gate red for every landing agent.

SCOPE: capture a failure traceback from a full-lane miss, then either isolate the
Models-panel commit-offer path from shared ACE/Textual state or harden the wait so
the modal assertion is not load-sensitive. Do not add the node to
tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt without a filed fix-or-retire decision.

Not a duplicate of sase-n5 (different models-panel node:
test_panel_mixed_bucket_sections_title_and_restore). sase-ct is a retired umbrella
and must not be +1'd. sase-j7 is the process-global leak epic; this node is ACE
modal timing until a traceback says otherwise.

Discovered while verifying monitor_node_under_starter; that tree does not touch
Models-panel edit outcomes.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-n5 — another Models-panel full-lane flake (test_panel_mixed_bucket_sections_title_and_restore). Different node and assertion; do not merge without a shared traceback.
RELATED: sase-ob — sibling flake-baseline node named in the same 2026-08-17 selection-health run (fakey usage-limit ULP compare). Separate defect.
RELATED: sase-mv — sibling flake-baseline node from the same run (config-cache selector invalidation). Separate defect; process-global config cache, not Models-panel modal timing.
RELATED: sase-j7 — in-progress process-global leak epic. This node is ACE ConfirmActionModal wait_for timing until a traceback says otherwise; do not treat it as a config-cache leak without evidence.
RELATED: sase-ns.6.6.6 — in-progress epic clearing the two red verification gates; this node is now one of the live flake-baseline holdouts.

evidence.note: Independently re-observed during epic sase-o9 landing at HEAD c715bacbc (2026-08-17), after the tree moved 6 commits past the description's evidence: just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake still names this node, now as one of only two baseline-exceeding flakes (the third, tests/test_config_cache.py::test_selector_change_eventually_invalidates_merged_config, is auto-excluded as no-longer-collectable since c715bacbc split that file). A fourth host-local record now carries the nodeid: 20260817T135250Z-15c6f89129db-3802987-full-run.json. The sase-o9 diff touches only Procs-pane/proc-observer/agent-jump code and docs, nothing in the Models panel. No new task created.

Independent reproduction while landing epic sase-ns.6.6.6 on master 5e58fb1c8 (workspace sase_16, from-scratch just install). `just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake` exits 1 naming this node as the ONLY reproducible flake exceeding tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt, after that epic retired the config-cache class (# fixed-at: 2026-08-17T15:32:01Z) and 9f8db519c retired the fakey usage-limit node (# fixed-at: 2026-08-17T15:40:00Z). This node is now the sole holdout keeping the gate -- and therefore every just check-full -- red for everyone, which raises its impact considerably from when it was filed. Also corroborated independently by epic phase sase-ns.6.6.6.4, which observed it fail on a full-lane escalation while passing in isolation, under xdist file-scoped, and on an immediate rerun.
